title: Portal Chats: Save to Storage opens the client's Storage screen, or Business
text: The Save to Storage button under a client's chat file used to open a card made only for ITIN letters. It now opens the client's own Storage screen in a pop-up with the chat file already loaded, so any file type works and you choose the folder, type, name, Show to client and Tell the client as in a normal upload. A Save in switch lets you file it in the firm's Business folders instead.
points: The ITIN letter card is still there, one click away.
In Business, open a folder first. The upload button stays disabled until you do.
A tax number in the file's name is replaced by x's in the saved name. The chat keeps the original name.
